AppCoreSpec.description: Applications v2: application core (status-coloured lights + segmented ring) with rate cards and status breakdown.

BoardSpec.description: Home-style board: ODIN globe readout, four capsules, stage row (Applications in processing).

orb.description: 'glass': a calm glass sphere replaces ODIN's globe for this answer.

centre.description: Replaces the total in the ring's centre (e.g. the closure rate the screen answers).

clean.description: No callouts: the legend is a separate component.

closure.description: Closure rate pill shown under the galaxy ring.

variant.description: 'galaxy' (Application Outcomes v2, wide): spiral galaxy in a dark portal, glass metric cards. 'cards' (Application Outcomes v1): 3D donut around the application core, four hero-glass cards.

FloorStageData.description: `split`: an outcome's total by route (without biometric / after biometric).

GlanceSpec.description: Glance answer (composer depth 1): one KPI inside ODIN's core, with two supporting facts.

item.description: Answer-first: the hero's composer measure, and the other asked metrics (cards beside ODIN).

lights.description: The sphere's lights (Applications v2 style): one light per application, coloured by status (gold for revenue).

emphasisKey.description: Stage with the most applications currently waiting (factual emphasis).

emphasisLabel.description: Tag on the emphasised stage (default "Most waiting now").

floor.description: Floor journey data (online map incl. biometric branch). Wide screens render it on the floor.

heading.description: Heading drawn inside the v2 jar board.

outcomeLabels.description: Outcome labels (default Approved / Rejected; centre visits: Visit completed / Missed).

variant.description: 'pedestals' (3.1 primary), 'orbs' (3.2 journey map) or 'jars' (online journey v2, wide).

LegendSpec.description: Status legend grid (2×2 glass pills) under a distribution ring.

ask.description: Follow-up question asked when the tile's chevron is pressed.

card.description: C · hero glass: glossy capsule glass carrying the chart, for a page's headline cards.

spark.description: Optional mini chart drawn in the card.

tile.description: Tinted glass KPI tile (icon badge, white ink, chevron).

PodiumColumn.description: `share`: the column's items are shares of all applications (centres are attributed applications only, so no share).

PodiumsSpec.description: v1 leaderboards (default) · v2 'skyline': glass pillars with rising particles. `total` = all applications (for shares).

PresenceMode.description: Where ODIN's globe goes in this scene.

highlight.description: Index highlighted (e.g. the leader or the item asked about).

preview.description: Post-October dimension shown as a labelled design preview.

breakdowns.description: v2 (revenue core): each dimension is a full breakdown of the same total.

layout.description: v3: the core in the centre, two breakdown panels on each side.

validation.description: v2: values shown, flagged "validation required" until AEGI Finance approves the definition.

backdrop.description: Backdrop blur this screen asks for (src/lib/backdrop.ts): 'dof' exterior lens blur, 'full' both layers. Default sharp.

beats.description: Answer view: the spectrum follows ODIN's words, one beat per metric ('globe' = the sphere, else a card's spot key).

depth.description: Composer depth that produced this scene (free-text questions only).

env.description: 'floor': the camera pushes onto the interior floor and the environment stays sharp. 'low': a gentle tilt down so cards can stand on the floor (Top countries v1).

spoken.description: Exactly what ODIN says — also what the summary strip highlights.

spot.description: Composer spotlight: the item the question asked about (screens mark items with data-spot-key).

previewNote.description: Online matrix: biometric-branch stage times are a design preview (F25 red).

sla.description: Ring around the centre readout (0–1); decorative frame when undefined.
